title: Possible features, known issues, and explained limits
summary: This topic clusters brief comments about whether certain features or fixes are possible, along with a few mentions of known bugs or pre-purchase understanding, so the examples do not form one coherent product issue.

negative.summary: The negative feedback is a regretful remark that a problem was apparently possible and not known earlier.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined comments mention feature limitations, charging schedule constraints, configuration restrictions, known bugs, and unclear pre-purchase knowledge without enough context to assign clear sentiment consistently.

limitations: Most examples are very short and lack enough context to determine clear sentiment or the exact underlying issue.
The cluster mixes unrelated subjects such as battery limits, dashboard customization, charging schedules, bugs, and purchase understanding, so a single concrete theme would be overstated.
Because the sample is sentiment-stratified and small, it should not be treated as representative of the broader model experience.
